-- Step 1: Archive current versions to history
INSERT INTO sequenceTemplateHistory (templateId, sequenceKey, touchKey, subjectLine, bodyText, bodyHtml, archivedAt, archiveReason)
SELECT id, sequenceKey, touchKey, subjectLine, bodyText, bodyHtml, NOW(), 'address_fix: 3945 Peachtree Pkwy → 2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd'
FROM sequenceTemplates
WHERE id IN (60001, 60002, 60003, 60004, 60005);

-- Step 2: Fix bodyText
UPDATE sequenceTemplates
SET bodyText = REPLACE(bodyText, '3945 Peachtree Pkwy, Suwanee GA 30024', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd, Suwanee, GA 30024'),
    bodyText = REPLACE(bodyText, '3945 Peachtree Pkwy, Suwanee, GA 30024', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd, Suwanee, GA 30024'),
    bodyText = REPLACE(bodyText, '3945 Peachtree Pkwy', '2005 Lawrenceville-Suwanee Rd')
